cwe_content.cwe: CWE-1236,Improper Neutralization of Formula Elements in a CSV File

candidate.Reason: Directly writes user-controlled data from the 'data' stream to CSV without sanitizing formula elements (such as =, +, -, @). This allows potential formula injection attacks where malicious formulas could be executed when the CSV is opened in spreadsheet applications.
Writes header array directly to CSV without sanitizing formula elements. If header values contain formula characters (=, +, -, @), they could be interpreted as formulas by spreadsheet applications.
